messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick sync post-all-hands. We asked for a clearer feedback loop on customer wins/losses and concrete deliverables so we stop repeating the same asks. Let's list top asks and owners.

Diego (VP Product): From Q&A notes: customers repeatedly said onboarding friction and lack of deterministic latency buckets cost us a few deals. They also asked for example promps/evals that show output parity across quantized configs.

Priya (CS): Field color: one CMP loss — they were worried about a single noisy tenant affecting latency for everyone. They wanted isolation options and a simple SLA line item.

Liam (Sales): Echo. Also a handful of pilots stalled because our quickstart didn't include a "what to measure in week 0" checklist. That makes it harder to build confidence.

Nora (Docs): I can produce a "Week 0 obs & metrics" checklist + a short how-to for running a smoke test. Will need example commands and expected ranges.

Kai (Eng): Technical note: we can produce latency buckets (p50/p95) per deployment mode and GPU class. We need to standardize measurement script. I'll own the script and baseline runs.

Diego (VP Product): Action items I propose: 1) Isolation + SLA blurb (owner: Priya + Kai), 2) Week 0 checklist + smoke test scripts (owner: Nora), 3) Quantized-eval examples and a short guide (owner: Kai + Nora), 4) TL;DR "why pick Dedicated vs Private" one-pager (owner: Liam).

Priya (CS): I'll draft the SLA blurb. It should be non-legal, field-facing: what we guarantee and what triggers remediation steps.

Liam (Sales): For the one-pager, include two quick case studies: a fintech with compliance needs and a high-volume chat API. Include recommended plan and top 3 config knobs.

Ava (CEO): Good. Priority order: SLA/Isolation blurb, Week 0 checklist, TL;DR migration one-pager, quantized-evals. Keep deliverables small and testable.

Nora (Docs): ETA for Week 0 checklist: 5 business days. I'll embed example curl commands and a minimal `perf_check.py` snippet.

Kai (Eng): ETA for measurement script + baseline numbers: 10 business days. Will publish a table with p50/p95 for 128/512/1k token prompts on A100, H100, and our CPU fallback.

Priya (CS): I'll also coordinate with the customer who lost the CMP deal and offer a short isolation design review.

Liam (Sales): Please CC me on the CMP follow-up. If they re-engage we should offer a short technical review.

Ava (CEO): Ops checklist: capture the recurring feature ask about "per-tenant throttles" for Dedicated. Is that an engineering backlog item or an enterprise feature?

Kai (Eng): It's a feature that requires infra work (rate-limiter + tenant isolation) — likely an enterprise roadmap item. I'll scope a rough implementation note.

Diego (VP Product): Diego: let's create a single tracking board with these 4 deliverables and owners + target dates. Put it in the product workspace and share the link here.

Nora (Docs): Uploaded draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/drafts/win-loss-feedback-1820023456 I'll add the Week 0 checklist now.

Priya (CS): Field note: customers appreciated our canary failover story. Let's make that more visible in the quickstart — a short "if failure happens" section with steps.

Liam (Sales): Also include a short cost-estimate snippet: "expected monthly spend for X queries/day" — that helps procurement.

Diego (VP Product): Noted. Add a tiny calculator or table for low/medium/high usage profiles.

Ava (CEO): OpsBot, please create tickets for: per-tenant throttles exploration, measurement-script RFC, and docs checklist publish.

OpsBot: Created tickets: #FEAT-923 (per-tenant throttles exploration) assigned to eng-infra, #RFC-4312 (measurement script + baselines) assigned to eng-runtime, #DOCS-210 (Week0 checklist publish) assigned to docs-team.

Kai (Eng): I'll start the RFC with an initial sketch of measurement harness and expected CI integration.

Nora (Docs): Quick question: should the Week 0 checklist live in the console help or in the public docs?

Ava (CEO): Both. Put a short help bubble in-console and link to the full doc. Keep the console copy under 120 chars.

Priya (CS): I'll draft the console copy: "Run these 3 checks to validate latency & throughput for your workload."

Liam (Sales): Any objection if I use the one-pager in deal decks as soon as the draft is ready?

Diego (VP Product): No objection, but flag any claims that require SLA sign-off.

Ava (CEO): Last item: we heard one repeated ask about better rollout case studies. Can we collect 3 short anonymized case studies (win, loss avoided, loss) for decks? Owner: Priya + Liam.

Priya (CS): Will collect and anonymize. ETA one week.

Liam (Sales): I'll help polish and add them to sales enablement.

Diego (VP Product): I'll post the tracking board link by EOD and tag owners.

Ava (CEO): Thanks. Close this thread after owners add their dates to the board. We'll review status in the next all-hands follow-up.

OpsBot: Reminder set: review tracking board in 10 business days.
